notes.title: Stuck in the dark? New hint system added!
notes.notes:
SOMNIFUGE now features a hint system, available at any time during gameplay. If a puzzle has you spiraling, open the escape menu and press the [b]HINT[/b] button. Press once for a subtle nudge, or twice for a more direct clue.

A new achievement has been added for completing the game using 5 hints or fewer. Your remaining hints are shown on the button.
